name: flash-sweep
note: no game strobes: every entry of tests/flash-sweep.json (a stretch of each game's brightest play, natively on GL) checked frame by frame with the engine's tools/flash-check.mjs (WCAG 2.3.1 / Harding general and red flash limits, no regular flicker above 3 Hz); each entry's control, the same frames with an 8 Hz full-screen strobe laid over them, must fail

name: hordeshooter-match
note: hordeshooter_auto: two bots hold the yard for 900 ticks (15 s). The crowd, the shots and the blasts are all simulation, so every host agrees on the state.

name: hordeshooter-pace
note: hordeshooter_auto: two bots for 40 s: first kill, the first upgrade choices (bots pick), wave 2. Exact state on every host. Re-pinned 2026-10-29 (H-PT5): a wave is 25 s now (LEVELS.md), so wave 2 starts at tick 1500, not 1800: more of the run is wave 2.

name: arenafps-match
note: arenafps_auto: four seats (the AUTO bot count adds none) play Foundry deathmatch by themselves for 20 seconds. The simulation (movers, navmesh paths, shots, rockets, pickups) must give the same state on every host, so fighters.pos, scores and the state hash are compared exactly; pixels within the usual tolerance (particles, decals). Control: one frame short. WebGPU vs GL within 40 percent: at frame 1200 two of the four views face a wall at arm's length, and close-up texture detail (normal and roughness maps at that distance) differs between the backends (33 percent of pixels over 16 levels, 42 to 50 percent in those two views, 19 to 21 in the others, mean brightness equal: an engine finding in internal-cartwheel/findings/arenafps.md). No shake (2026-10-29): cam.offset is every view's camera as drawn against the eye and aim on the 575 ticks (655 before grenades and power-ups, 750 before their tuning, 755 before grenades finished fights, 2026-11-08) within half a second of a hit taken or a blast within 14 m; none is off by over 0.1 mm or 0.1 milliradian (a build with the old shake measured 575 of 581 off, up to 14 cm and radians summed). rumble.sent: blasts, hits taken, hits dealt and kills, landings, rocket and rail shots sent to the players' pads; cw.rumble the engine's last request. The gate pins High with a start command: Chromium is not a deterministic host, so Auto stays on there and since engine v0.27 it steps down on a loaded machine.

name: arenafps-screenshot
note: A four-way split frame is a real picture (the arenas' colours, HUD, effects), not one flat colour. Pixels within 1 percent: a spent casing in flight (a visual particle) and the 1 px edges of the HUD bars differ between native GL and the dual cart on romdev GL (0.32 percent measured); the match gate allows 8 percent for the same reasons.

name: arenafps-coop
note: Co-op waves, three players (bots fill the seats) in the Courtyard: wave spawns, lives and bot paths must agree on every host. Control: two players.

name: arenafps-tdm
note: Team deathmatch in the Terraces (water), four players and four bots, 30 s. Control: three players.

name: arenafps-recoil
note: recoil belongs to the gun model, never the view (no camera shake). One pad through the setup with no bots, then hold the trigger with the look stick at rest for 3 and 2 seconds: cam.fire counts the ticks fired and those on which the view moved; the rifle's burst walks its shots and opens the crosshair instead. Control ARENA_RECOIL_BUG=1 (the old climb) moves the view on every shot. The gate pins High with a start command: Chromium is not a deterministic host, so Auto stays on there and since engine v0.27 it steps down on a loaded machine.

name: arenafps-camera
note: camera stability, the way a person plays: one pad through title, join and the setup (no bots: up three rows, right, down three, fire), then stand, walk, stop, strafe, jump and stand on Foundry while player 1's camera as drawn is measured every tick (cam.gate: ticks at rest, at-rest ticks that moved over 1 mm, ticks in motion, ticks in motion on the ground where the eye jumped over 0.6 m or its step changed by over 15 cm). At rest it must not move at all (no bob, roll, dip or sway); stairs and kerbs ease the eye up instead of snapping it. Measured on engine v0.25.0: [478, 0, 650, 0] on native GL and WebGPU (it was [528, 0, 600, 0] before fighters spawned facing the longest clear way: the split between rest and motion moved, the two zeros did not). The control (ARENA_CAM_BUG, native) puts a 1 cm idle sway on the camera, so the second number leaves zero: it must differ. The gate pins High with a start command: Chromium is not a deterministic host, so Auto stays on there and since engine v0.27 it steps down on a loaded machine.

name: hordeshooter-calm-camera
note: no camera shake: three bots at the run's wave 13 (the ossuary's wave 3, its own level) for 900 ticks (112 blasts: rockets, grenades, bloaters, mines). view.cam_jerks counts frames whose camera position has a second difference over 2 cm (a shake; the smooth follow never does): 0. cw.rumble (requests, pad, low and high in thousandths, ms) shows the pads rumble instead: 175 requests, the last a blast. Re-measured 2026-10-29 on native GL when the ossuary came in (was 178 blasts in the yard). The control (HORDE_SHAKE_CONTROL, the same 900 ticks) puts the old explosion-kit camera shake back: 731 jerking frames and the same game.hash (the shake was never in the simulation), so it must differ.

name: hordeshooter-melee
note: enemy melee: one player standing still while a runner and a brute walk in (HORDE_MELEE_TEST, no spawning). Each attack plays its clip (melee.attack_frames: frames that drew an enemy in a wind-up, strike or recovery pose: 352) and its damage lands on the strike tick, the wind-up after it began (melee.hit_delay per kind: the runner 15 ticks, the brute 34), not on touch: 14 strikes, 10 hits, the player downed (-3 hp). Measured 2026-10-29 on native GL. The control (HORDE_MELEE_DODGE=1: the player steps away from every wind-up) must differ.

name: hordeshooter-melee-dodge
note: dodging works: the same scene with the player stepping straight away from every enemy winding up at it (HORDE_MELEE_DODGE=1): 9 strikes, 0 hits, full health (the damage needs the player still in reach and in front on the strike tick). Measured 2026-10-29 on native GL. The control (HORDE_MELEE_DODGE=0: standing still) takes hits and must differ.

name: hordeshooter-melee-dash
note: the dash: the same scene, the player waiting until each strike is three ticks away and then dashing out (HORDE_MELEE_DODGE=2): 9 strikes and 4 hits, 50 hp (it was 6 and 1, 82 hp, until the dash stopped against big bodies on 2026-11-08: twice here the way out runs into the brute, which now stops it, game.dash [0,2,0]). The control (HORDE_MELEE_DODGE=3: the same late moment, a step and no dash) takes 11 hits of 14 strikes and ends on 1 hp: a step that late is too slow. Measured 2026-11-08 on native GL.

name: hordeshooter-dash-through
note: The dash and the crowd (2026-11-08): one player with three runners to its right and a brute walking in from its left (HORDE_DASH_TEST). It dashes left: the brute stops it dead, the player left touching it (anything half a metre round or more does: a brute, a bloater, a slagborn, a boss). Then it dashes right: through the runners, each shoved off the dash line to its nearer side. game.dash counts the small ones dashed through, the dashes a big one stopped and the small ones a Boots + Armor dash bowled over; player.x where it ended. The control (HORDE_OLD_DASH) goes through everything: nothing is counted and the first dash carries on past the brute, so it fails.

name: hordeshooter-synergy
note: Upgrades that combine (2026-11-08): two bots that dash (HORDE_BOT_DASH) hold the yard for 15 s, each starting with Piercing, Extra barrel, Rockets, Bigger blasts, Boots and Armor (HORDE_UPGRADES). Piercing with Extra barrel fans the starting gun out wide and every round goes through one more; Rockets with Bigger blasts burst into three small blasts round each rocket; Boots with Armor make the dash bowl the small ones over. player.synergy holds each player's (bits 1, 2, 4); the upgrade card that would start one says so (+ combines: ...). The control (HORDE_NO_SYNERGY) never combines them: the same team kills fewer, so it fails.

name: hordeshooter-knock
note: Each gun its own knockback (2026-11-08): two bots hold the yard with the shotgun. A hit pushes along the shot by the gun, not by the round's speed as before: the starting gun's rounds 0.38 m/s as they were, a shotgun pellet 2.4 times that (it was no more than a round), the minigun's light rounds 0.6, the rail and the stake a shove (3.2 and 2.2), the flamer and hellfire none (the flame used to push a third of a round). game.knock: bullet hits and the push they gave in mm. The starting gun pushes as it did, so hordeshooter-match keeps its hash. The control (HORDE_OLD_KNOCK) pushes by speed: the pellets push far less, so it fails.

Measured 2026-10-29 on native GL. The control (HORDE_FLOOR_STAY=1: nobody steps in) stays on the first floor with the hatch open and must differ.

name: arenafps-quality

A scene not reached fails. Control: a state the scene draws out of the table must be reported and skip draws

name: arenafps-killcam
note: a downed player's view turns to whoever downed them and follows them until the respawn: on 90 percent or more of the dead ticks (after the turn) the killer's chest is inside that player's view (software GL, two seats and four bots on Foundry). Control: ARENA_NO_KILLCAM=1, the old view on the floor, must fall under it

name: hordeshooter-grounding
note: nothing floats: every prop of the yard and of each deeper floor has a dark band at its foot on Very Low and High (against the same frame with no contact shadows), and nothing of the crowd is drawn sunk into a closed hatch. Controls: two runs with no contact shadows find no dark foot; the crowd drawn at floor level sinks into the hatch

name: hordeshooter-newcomer
note: a newcomer plays the Yard on the cart through romdev, GL and WebGPU, from power-on by the pad and what the picture shows (nc.look: the enemies, boss, gems and power-ups inside the picture, the cards, the STEP IN marker), with a 0.3 s reaction delay, a wandering aim error of up to 12 degrees, steering jitter, a dash only some of the times it could and a second to read the cards: the boss falls and the player steps down to floor 2, alone and beside a second pad that joined and never plays (the horde sized for one, game.crew 1, and the yard slowed for the cards), with a pause and resume. Controls: with no STEP IN marker (sw no_marker 1) the way down is not found in 90 s; the old rule (sw idle_crew 1) sizes the horde for the idle seat (game.crew 2) and never slows.
